text: Calves are the most stubborn muscle in your body. Still got skinny legs?
Most people bounce through tiny half reps. That's your Achilles tendon springing, not your calf working.
Go all the way down, and pause for two seconds in the stretch. One study found the bottom half grew calves more.
Straight knees train the gastrocnemius. Bent knees train the soleus underneath. Do both.
Ten to twenty slow reps, close to failure, two or three times a week. Save this.
